controls.title: No hardcoded secrets in code or versioned configuration
controls.objective: Ensure passwords, keys and tokens are not in clear text and come from vault or environment variables.
controls.test_procedure: List files via GET /api/repo/paiement-api/tree, search via GET /api/repo/paiement-api/search?q=(?i)(password|passwd|pwd|secret|api[_-]?key|token)\s*=\s*['\"][^'\"]+['\"] and via GET /api/repo/paiement-api/search?q=os\.environ|os\.getenv|vault|secrets\.manager, then read app/config.py and any config files via GET /api/repo/paiement-api/file?path=<file> to verify secret sourcing.
controls.expected: Zero matches with clear-text secret literals; all secrets reference os.environ, os.getenv or vault client.
controls.risk: Hardcoded credentials exposure leading to unauthorized access to production and data.
controls.recommendation: Remove hardcoded secrets and load them from a vault or environment variables.
controls.cause: Developer convenience hardcoding credentials for local testing.
controls.quote: Aucun secret (mot de passe, clé, jeton) n'est écrit en clair dans le code source ni dans la configuration versionnée : les secrets viennent d'un coffre ou de variables d'environnement.

controls.title: TLS certificate verification never disabled
controls.objective: Ensure outgoing calls verify server TLS certificates.
controls.test_procedure: Search via GET /api/repo/paiement-api/search?q=verify\s*=\s*False and via GET /api/repo/paiement-api/search?q=CERT_NONE|_create_unverified_context|check_hostname\s*=\s*False, list files via GET /api/repo/paiement-api/tree and read network client files via GET /api/repo/paiement-api/file?path=<file>.
controls.expected: Zero matches for verify=False, CERT_NONE, unverified context or disabled hostname check.
controls.risk: Man-in-the-middle interception of SEPA transfer data and credentials.
controls.recommendation: Remove any TLS verification bypass and retain default certificate verification.
controls.cause: Temporary bypass of TLS verification left in code for local development.
controls.quote: Tout appel réseau sortant vérifie le certificat TLS du serveur : la vérification n'est jamais désactivée (`verify=False` interdit).

controls.title: Password hashing uses approved algorithm
controls.objective: Ensure passwords are hashed with argon2, bcrypt, scrypt or PBKDF2.
controls.test_procedure: Search via GET /api/repo/paiement-api/search?q=argon2|bcrypt|scrypt|pbkdf2|passlib and read password handling files via GET /api/repo/paiement-api/file?path=<file> to confirm hashing call for passwords.
controls.expected: Password hashing code uses one of argon2, bcrypt, scrypt or PBKDF2.
controls.risk: Weak password storage enabling credential recovery after database disclosure.
controls.recommendation: Migrate password hashing to argon2, bcrypt, scrypt or PBKDF2.
controls.cause: Use of legacy example code with fast hashes.
controls.quote: Les mots de passe sont hachés avec argon2, bcrypt, scrypt ou PBKDF2. MD5 et SHA-1 sont interdits pour tout usage de sécurité.

controls.title: MD5 and SHA-1 forbidden for security use
controls.objective: Ensure MD5 and SHA-1 are not used for security purposes.
controls.test_procedure: Search via GET /api/repo/paiement-api/search?q=hashlib\.(md5|sha1)|\bMD5\b|\bSHA-?1\b|hashlib\.new\(['\"]?(md5|sha1) and read matches via GET /api/repo/paiement-api/file?path=<file> to exclude non-security use.
controls.expected: Zero matches for MD5 or SHA-1 in security context.
controls.risk: Collision and brute-force attacks due to broken hash functions.
controls.recommendation: Replace MD5 and SHA-1 with approved password hashing.
controls.quote: Les mots de passe sont hachés avec argon2, bcrypt, scrypt ou PBKDF2. MD5 et SHA-1 sont interdits pour tout usage de sécurité.

controls.title: CI runs static security analysis on every change
controls.objective: Verify CI executes bandit, semgrep or CodeQL on each modification.
controls.test_procedure: List files via GET /api/repo/paiement-api/tree to find .github/workflows files, read each via GET /api/repo/paiement-api/file?path=.github/workflows/ci.yml and search via GET /api/repo/paiement-api/search?q=bandit|semgrep|CodeQL|codeql to confirm analysis step and trigger.
controls.expected: A workflow triggered on push and pull_request contains a step invoking bandit, semgrep or CodeQL.
controls.risk: Undetected code vulnerabilities reaching production without static review.
controls.recommendation: Add bandit, semgrep or CodeQL step to CI on every push and pull request.
controls.cause: Security scanning omitted from initial pipeline setup.
controls.quote: La chaîne d'intégration continue exécute une analyse statique de sécurité (bandit, semgrep ou CodeQL) à chaque modification.

controls.title: Dependencies pinned to exact version
controls.objective: Ensure every dependency is pinned with == to an exact version.
controls.test_procedure: List files via GET /api/repo/paiement-api/tree, read requirements.txt via GET /api/repo/paiement-api/file?path=requirements.txt and verify each non-comment line matches exact pin pattern.
controls.expected: Every dependency line in requirements.txt uses == exact pin with no >=, ~=, *, or unpinned entries.
controls.risk: Non-reproducible builds and silent introduction of vulnerable transitive versions.
controls.recommendation: Pin all dependencies to exact versions with ==.
controls.cause: Use of flexible version specifiers for convenience.
controls.quote: Les dépendances sont épinglées à une version exacte (`paquet==version`) et auditées en intégration continue (pip-audit ou équivalent).

controls.title: Dependencies audited in CI
controls.objective: Ensure dependencies are audited in CI with pip-audit or equivalent.
controls.test_procedure: List files via GET /api/repo/paiement-api/tree, read workflow files via GET /api/repo/paiement-api/file?path=.github/workflows/ci.yml and search via GET /api/repo/paiement-api/search?q=pip-audit|safety|dependabot|osv-scanner to confirm audit step.
controls.expected: CI workflow contains a step invoking pip-audit or equivalent audit on dependencies.
controls.risk: Known vulnerable packages deployed without detection at integration.
controls.recommendation: Add pip-audit or equivalent audit step to CI.
controls.cause: Vulnerability scanning not added to pipeline.
controls.quote: Les dépendances sont épinglées à une version exacte (`paquet==version`) et auditées en intégration continue (pip-audit ou équivalent).

controls.title: Test data declared synthetic with no production export
controls.objective: Ensure test data is synthetic with synthetic true and no production dump versioned.
controls.test_procedure: List files via GET /api/repo/paiement-api/tree to review tests and fixtures, search via GET /api/repo/paiement-api/search?q=synthetic and read fixture files via GET /api/repo/paiement-api/file?path=<file> to verify declaration.
controls.expected: Fixture files contain "synthetic": true and tree shows no production export or dump files.
controls.risk: Production personal and payment data exposure in non-production via versioned exports.
controls.recommendation: Replace test data with synthetic data flagged synthetic true and remove production exports.
controls.cause: Copy of production data for realistic testing.
controls.quote: Les données de test sont synthétiques et déclarées comme telles (champ `"synthetic": true`) ; aucun export de production n'est versionné.

controls.title: Authentication successes and failures are logged
controls.objective: Ensure the application logs both successful and failed authentications.
controls.test_procedure: Search via GET /api/repo/paiement-api/search?q=log.*auth|auth.*log|login.*log|logger\.(info|warning|error) and via GET /api/repo/paiement-api/search?q=authentication|login_failed|login_success, then read matches via GET /api/repo/paiement-api/file?path=<file>.
controls.expected: Code contains logging calls covering both authentication success and authentication failure events.
controls.risk: Undetected credential attacks and missing audit trail for access review.
controls.recommendation: Add application logging for both authentication successes and failures.
controls.cause: Logging limited to errors without authentication events.
controls.quote: Les réussites et les échecs d'authentification sont journalisés par l'application.
